from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "d6114a1564542b17309f91423d533345c8056307"
head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
branch = subprocess.check_output(["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
status = subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()

print(f"branch={branch}")
print(f"head={head}")
print(f"clean={not bool(status)}")

if head != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"isolated worktree head changed: expected {expected}, observed {head}")
if branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated branch: {branch}")
if status:
    raise SystemExit("isolated worktree is not clean")

targets = [
    wt / "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    wt / "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    wt / "tests/test_browser.py",
    wt / "tests/test_daemon.py",
]
needles = ("notify_receipt", "notify_receipts", "browser_status", "pending_receipts", "receipt", "ack")

for path in targets:
    print(f"=== {path.relative_to(wt)} ===")
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    hit_lines = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if any(n in line for n in needles)]
    emitted = set()
    for hit in hit_lines[:50]:
        start = max(1, hit - 3)
        end = min(len(lines), hit + 6)
        if (start, end) in emitted:
            continue
        emitted.add((start, end))
        print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start, end + 1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")
